name: meee2
description: Turn natural-language business processes into governed Meee2 workflow canvases with trackers and schedules, then execute nodes and write structured artifacts back.

interface.shortDescription: Create and run governed Meee2 workflows
interface.longDescription: Adds the Meee2 Skill and MCP bridge so Codex can propose a complete workflow from natural language, materialize an approved Canvas with tracker contracts and recurring jobs, and execute planner nodes with structured artifact writeback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Meee2 to turn this business process into a clear workflow proposal and open the single required approval in the Board; create the Canvas only after I approve there, and keep recurring jobs disabled until I separately approve enabling them
